children: Liquid Capital founder Jack Yi said Bitcoin has seen a mild pullback as expected and that another decline toward about $75,500 would present a new opportunity. According to ChainCatcher, he said he remains bullish on further upside after a small correction.

Yi also reflected on his experience in investing and trading, saying he entered the BTC market in 2015 at a low point through mining and later made successful investments in Quantum and other projects during the 2017 bull market. He said that success was largely due to luck, and added that he later invested in hundreds of projects, with most failing and only a few succeeding.

He said that as investment opportunities decreased, he began studying trading more seriously. Yi added that trading requires greater caution, noting that even after nine consecutive successful trades, one failure can erase prior gains.

title: Liquid Capital Founder Jack Yi Says Bitcoin Pullback Near $75,500 Could Offer a New Entry
